ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Use MSHTA - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via use MSHTA in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*mshta.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*vbscript\\:createobject.*")))
